alternative_public_inputs: DES Y6 publishes LambdaCDM S8=0.789 +/-0.012 and a public PPD code repository; neither by itself provides the model-specific frozen S9 likelihood.

exact_prereg.claim: With correct nonlinear power (CLASS halofit patched for scalar fields, class_halofit_scf_patch.py), at the frozen full-data Dovekie backgrounds (class_fit_dovekie.json), the next cosmic-shear releases (DES Y6, KiDS successor, HSC Y3 or Euclid DR1, scored with this repo's likelihood conventions: NLA, no baryons, cuts xi+ > 10', xi- > 60') will NOT separate CPL from the fading coupling: |Delta chi2(CPL - fading c<0)| < 2 per survey after refitting nuisances, and every evolving model (fading c<0, c>0, CPL) within 4 in chi2 of LCDM.
exact_prereg.falsified_if: |Delta chi2(CPL - fading c<0)| >= 2 on any one release, or any evolving model better than LCDM by more than 4 or worse by more than 4.
exact_prereg.supersedes: S8 (prereg_highz.json, sha 3074f15e) and the sign clauses of S1/S7, whose evidence was the halofit bug (Pass 12632); those files stay unedited

required_pipeline_artifacts: actual unblinded xi+/- vector with correct bin and scale metadata
matched full covariance, and exact scale-cut indices
source redshift n(z) and calibration covariance
intrinsic alignment and other systematics nuisance priors
patched CLASS/Halofit for CPL and fading c<0 cosmologies
same-data nuisance refits for each model
frozen absolute Delta_chi2 score and LCDM-envelope checks
scientific_disposition: Fail closed. No claim of S9 success or failure, no fake sigma from LambdaCDM-only S8 marginal.
why: No validated complete unblinded DES Y6 xi+/- FITS vector plus matching covariance and corrected CLASS/Halofit scalar-field predictions/nuisance re-optimization in this run.
